title: UTA artwork montage edit record
description: A record in stories/uta-general-dark-army.json: the rights position, the pinned source identity, and the Argo-returned measurements for a montage cut to Unleash The Archers' General Of The Dark Army. This montage uses the official source video's complete audio timeline, so rights and audio provenance live in the montage's own source object instead of a reusable beat-grid bed record. The repository stores measurements and references, never the media.
$comment: Structural discriminators -- the build_workflow kinds source-review, picture and mux-validate, the composition mode and the timeline entry kinds -- are schema-local generator branches, not shared domain vocabulary. They are deliberately absent from vocab/ and from scripts/generate_schema_enums.py's MAP. The one shared-vocabulary field is source.usage_class, whose enum is generated from vocab/provenance.yaml.

_what.description: Prose orientation for the record, in the house style of stories/*.json.

edit_id.description: Stable slug, referenced on the command line and in workflow names.

youtube_id.description: The requested YouTube video ID. Pinned by the owner; the record is wrong if it drifts.

source_url.description: Canonical watch URL for the requested source.

usage_class.description: Rights bucket, generated from vocab/provenance.yaml's usage_class axis -- never hand-edited here.

source_rights_note.description: Human-readable rights position. For this montage it must state the same copyrighted work is used as both bed and selected picture, and that the repository stores only measurements and references.

media_filename.description: The source file name inside the Hero work directory, served over the transport. The record travels; the media never does.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the requested source file, verified inside the fetch pod on every workflow that touches it.

duration_seconds.description: Authoritative container duration from the Argo source-probe.json, not the YouTube metadata summary.

frame_rate.description: Authoritative average frame rate as an exact rational (avg_frame_rate) from the Argo source probe.

frame_count.description: Authoritative video frame count (nb_frames) from the Argo source probe.

time_base.description: Authoritative video time base from the Argo source probe.

audio_sample_rate_hz.description: Native audio sample rate. Delivery is 48,000 Hz: a source whose rate is anything else hard-fails the bed gate, so a montage record carrying another value can never produce a valid bed and is rejected here.

decoded_sample_count.description: Exact decoded PCM sample count of the complete source audio (duration_ts of the pcm_s24le decode at 1/48000), established by the remote preflight and proven by the Stage 1 bed-format gate.

evidence.description: Where each measurement came from: Argo workflow names, manifest paths, and returned-artifact names. A measurement without evidence is a guess, and guesses do not go in this record.

width.description: Authoritative source frame width in pixels from the Argo source probe; overlay boxes are validated against it.

height.description: Authoritative source frame height in pixels from the Argo source probe; overlay boxes are validated against it.

fetch_url.description: LAN URL the workflows GET the source from (shared source server, port 8877).

receiver_url.description: LAN URL of this video's own PUT receiver (port 8881 for .work-uta-general). The receiver flattens PUT paths, so generated workflows upload flat filenames and any local organization into subdirectories is a documented move, never a claimed preservation.

composition.description: The montage's visual treatment policy (owner bar, 2026-09-05, refined same day from the attached example frame review/owner-composition-example-2026-09-05.png): artwork ALONGSIDE the official video by using each shot's EXISTING negative space -- the source frame is preserved and eyelines respected, with isolated transparent RAFI/Lakshmi figures and weapons placed in the reviewed empty region. Shot-authored placement: per-segment anchors and boxes chosen from manual scene review, never a forced generic split panel, never a uniform 50/50 crop, never over faces or action. Not black pillarboxes, not pasted rectangles, not slideshow cuts.

mode.description: The primary and default treatment: the source frame is preserved (source-preserve mode) and transparent art occupies the shot's reviewed negative space. A deliberate per-segment panel reframe (kind: panel) or a rare full-screen accent remains available, but neither is the default.

background.description: Layered background treatment derived from the source/art (for example an enlarged blurred source fill under the panel). Black pillarboxes are forbidden.

transition_frames.description: Every treatment change is a smooth transition within these bounds -- hard slideshow cuts are forbidden.

artwork_within_first_seconds.description: Artwork is visible from the opening and repeatedly within the first 35 seconds; the video must not read as source-only at the start.

accent_only_fullscreen.description: Full-screen artwork is a deliberate occasional accent only, never the primary treatment.

protect_direct_camera_singer_shots.description: Direct-camera singer shots play as clean full-frame source; the concrete intervals come from the reviewed storyboard/source-review evidence, never from automated gaze detection.

protected.description: Intervals that play as untouched full-frame source: no art, crop, reframing, card, transition, or filter may touch them. Must wholly contain 5:20-5:50 (320-350 s).

timeline.description: The composed edit itself, filled by a later task from the reviewed evidence (scene times, contact sheet, review frames, storyboard). kind overlay is the default: source preserved, art in negative space. panel reframes the source into an explicit region where the shot has no usable negative space. accent is a rare full-screen artwork moment. source-only covers protected and direct-camera singer intervals.

overlays.description: Art placements for overlay/panel/accent kinds; forbidden on source-only. Each placement is shot-authored from manual scene review.

art_asset.description: An id from composition.assets; invented art is rejected.

anchor.description: The negative-space region the art occupies, named from manual scene review (for example: subjects in the left third, art anchored right).

box.description: The reviewed empty rectangle in SOURCE-frame pixels (2048x1152 space); the picture workflow maps it into the delivery frame. Must never cover faces or action.

scale.description: Art height as a fraction of the box height; 1 fills the box.

z_order.description: Stacking order among this segment's overlay layers; higher is closer to the viewer. The derived background layer is always below every overlay.

assets.description: Registry of existing transparent art assets (figure/weapon PNGs) an overlay may name. Every entry is an existing source-backed file in the Hero work directory; new art is never invented. Occasional variety (for example the dinosaur/'chonker' artwork) is added only when a source-backed asset actually exists.

file.description: Asset file inside the Hero work directory's assets/.
